abstract:
**β- Nicotinamide mononucleotide powder** is also called **NMN supplement powder**, a synthetic substrate of coenzyme I, while NMN has also been used in anti-aging research. Keio University in Japan and Washington University in the United States are conducting human clinical trials on the anti-aging effects and safety of β-NMN. Research shows, β- NMN can also play a regulatory role on insulin secretion, and the expression levels of mRNA, β- NMN has a wide range of application prospects in the field of medical treatment. β- Nicotinamide mononucleotide powder is the product of the extracellular nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (enampt) reaction and an intermediate of key NAD +. It improves glucose tolerance by restoring NAD + levels in HFD induced T2D mice. It also enhances hepatic insulin sensitivity and restores gene expression related to oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and circadian rhythm in part through SIRT1 activation.  
Molecular Formula:C11H15N2O8P  
Properties: White powder

5\. NMN delays aging  
Studies have found that supplementation of NMN accelerates the turnover of NAD+ salvage biosynthesis, thereby activating the Sirt1 response. Sirt1 can induce DNA silencing, which is helpful for anti-aging and prolonging the lifespan.  
6\. The therapeutic effect of **NMN supplement powder** on type 2 diabetes  
It was found that NMN can improve islet dysfunction in mice in the high fructose group, reverse the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokine-mediated changes in the expression of pancreatic islet marker genes, reduce the expression of pro-inflammatory factors, restore insulin secretion, and improve cytokine-mediated islets disfunction.  
7\. The therapeutic effect of NMN on acute kidney injury  
Studies have shown that the levels of SIRT1 and NAD + decrease with age; Reduced NAD + and SIRT1 in the kidney of aged organisms leads to increased susceptibility to AKI; NMN supplementation protects mice from cisplatin (which can be used to inhibit the replication of DNA) - induced AKI; The mechanism by which NAD + / SIRT1 protects the kidney involves epigenetic regulation of the JNK pathway.  
8\. The therapeutic effect of pure nmn powder on vascular disorders
8\. The therapeutic effect of pure nmn powder on vascular disorders  
β- Nicotinamide mononucleotide powder supplementation reduces collagen accumulation throughout blood vessels, increases arterial elastin accumulation, decreases arteriosclerosis, and delays arterial aging that occurs with advancing age. Additionally, NMN can also improve lipid distribution in plasma and maintain blood glucose levels, leading to improved vascular function.  
9\. The therapeutic effect of NMN on degenerative diseases of vision  
NMN supplementation restored normal basal glycolytic function, mitochondrial function, and the ability to adapt to metabolic stress in mice, reduced photoreceptor cell death, and significantly improved dark vision and retinal function.
